One-third of 60 acres is clay-rich:

- Clay-rich acres: \(60 \div 3 = 20\)
- Good-soil acres: \(60 - 20 = 40\)

Yields:
- Good soil: 400 bushels per acre
- Clay-rich soil: half of 400, so \(200\) bushels per acre

Total corn yield:
- Good soil: \(40 \times 400 = 16000\)
- Clay-rich soil: \(20 \times 200 = 4000\)

Total:
\(16000 + 4000 = 20000\)

Final answer: 20000
